definition: Codex CLI is an open-source artificial intelligence coding agent developed by OpenAI.
details: It operates through a command-line interface and can read and modify files, execute commands, and perform software development tasks on a user's local computer. Codex CLI is part of OpenAI's broader Codex software-development platform, alongside Codex extensions for integrated development environments, desktop applications, and cloud-based development.
story: Imagine handing a to-do list to a very clever intern who refuses to guess: before each step, they look around, check the result, and adjust. It is the difference between a search engine and a helper who actually finishes the task. The machine stops just answering one question and starts getting a job done, step by step, checking its work along the way. It is a loop of look, act, and learn — the same way you cook from a recipe you have never tried: add, taste, correct. And that habit of checking, acting, then checking again is Codex CLI.
